name: Intelia Instowranda Andreas
original_name: 茵媞莉雅·因斯托兰达·安德里亚斯
source:
During the rebellion in the territory where hук father died, she was rescued by the pacification army led by Emperor Thrantu himself. She followed the Emperor back to the capital and inherited her father's title. Before the arrival of Irell, she was the teacher of the princesses in the garden. She is an elegant and elegant young lady of a noble family. With her sharp insight and good upbringing from a noble family, even now, after Irell's arrival in the garden and her retirement as an assistant tutor, Intelia is still quite dependable - although it is her hobby to verbally tease those who ask for her help, it does not affect the reliability of her advice in any way.
Similar to most noblewomen, her physical strength is so poor that she is unable to use it to its full potential, even though she is not as good at domestic work and swordplay as a well-bred person. She is very popular among the people because she is an all-rounder in domestic affairs, and she is very knowledgeable and understands the ideas of others, although her own ideas and positions are not very prominent.

Translated with DeepL from [url=https://www.baike.com/wikiid/4766777124934008990]baike[/url]
